'''Jeff Ermis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Austin tournament (9 June)]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]], according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2426">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-austin-texas-6-9-01d2426/ austin-texas-6-9-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 9 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-austin-texas-6-9-01d2426/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
